adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a raw HTML ingestion path for feed imports that bypasses Discourse’s normal cooking/sanitization. In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, feed item content is only `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and then passed to `TopicEmbed.import`. `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts via `PostCreator.new(... raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents), skip_validations: true, cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html])`. In `Post#cook`, `raw_html` returns `raw` directly, skipping the rendering/sanitization pipeline. As a result, arbitrary HTML (including `<script>`, event handlers like `onerror`, iframes, etc.) from a compromised/third-party feed would be stored and rendered, enabling XSS on the forum origin.
